Job description
Job Objective:
As an AI Scientist, you will design and build scalable AI and Machine Learning solutions to solve complex business problems. You will work at the intersection of research and engineering, leveraging large-scale data to develop intelligent systems that improve user experience, personalization, recommendations, predictive intelligence, and business outcomes.
Job Description
As an AI Scientist, you will:
Design and develop Machine Learning algorithms and intelligent systems to extract insights from large-scale structured and unstructured data, including user profiles, behavioral data, text, images, and other multimodal data sources.
Identify high-impact business problems that can be solved using Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning.
Translate business challenges into scalable AI/ML solutions by defining problem statements, success metrics, experimentation strategies, and measurable business outcomes.
Build data-driven Machine Learning solutions to improve personalization, recommendation systems, predictive modeling, user preference prediction, engagement, retention, conversion, and revenue optimization.
Develop intelligent models that leverage large-scale behavioral signals to enhance user understanding, content relevance, and predictive decision-making.
Apply state-of-the-art Machine Learning and Deep Learning techniques across Predictive Modeling, NLP, Information Retrieval, Semantic Search, Learning-to-Rank (LTR), Recommendation Systems, and Generative AI where appropriate.
Design scalable, distributed, and real-time AI systems capable of processing large-scale datasets using modern data processing frameworks and cloud infrastructure.
Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Business teams to deliver production-grade AI solutions with measurable business impact.
Stay current with the latest advancements in Artificial Intelligence through research publications, open-source communities, conferences, and continuous experimentation.
Required Skills
3–5 years of hands-on industry experience in Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Deep Learning, or related domains.
Strong foundation in Probability, Statistics, Linear Algebra, Optimization, and Machine Learning fundamentals.
Strong applied experience solving real-world business problems using Machine Learning techniques including classification, regression, forecasting, recommendation systems, supervised, unsupervised, semi-supervised, and representation learning.
Hands-on experience with Deep Learning architectures (e.g., CNNs, RNNs, LSTMs, GRUs, and Transformer-based models) using frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.
Strong programming skills in Python with experience using machine learning libraries such as Scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, and related ecosystems.
Experience developing, evaluating, deploying, and monitoring Machine Learning models in production environments.
Experience working with large-scale datasets, feature engineering, data pipelines, and distributed data processing frameworks.
Excellent analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and a research-oriented mindset.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with Recommendation Systems, Personalization, Information Retrieval, NLP, Large Language Models (LLMs), or Semantic Search.
Experience building AI/ML solutions that drive measurable business outcomes such as user engagement, conversion, retention, revenue growth, or operational efficiency.
Experience with experimentation frameworks, A/B testing, model monitoring, and MLOps practices.
Publications, patents, open-source contributions, or participation in AI research communities are a plus.
